time_basis: NEM time (AEST, UTC+10, no daylight saving); interval-ending

columns.region: NEM region id (NSW1, QLD1, VIC1, SA1, TAS1)
columns.interval_end: end of the half-hour, NEM time
columns.demand_mw: operational demand (TOTALDEMAND), MW, time-weighted mean over the half-hour
columns.rrp: regional reference price, $/MWh, time-weighted mean over the half-hour
columns.n_intervals: source intervals averaged (6 for 5-minute data, 1 for 30-minute)
columns.resolution_min: source resolution in minutes (30 before Oct 2021, then 5)
